verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a terminal coding agent that stores conversation threads, but the evidence documents no retention policy, no thread or history deletion, and no data-purge controls. Choosing local SQLite versus a remote database (docs-15) only sets where data is stored. Deleting recurring prompts (docs-30) is a scheduling feature, not data deletion. Both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
